newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat futures remain poised, do not trade.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat futures remain poised, do not trade.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) wheat futures remained poised in a delicate balance on Monday with buyers and sellers both staying out of the market.
No trades went through on the SFE, while the settlement price for January 1997 futures edged ahead by A$1.00 to A$152.00 a tonne.
SFE wheat mirrored Chicago's mixed close on Friday, Gary Booth of Ord Minnett Jardine Fleming Futures Ltd said.
"No-one's keen to buy ahead of the break," he said.
The market remained poised at a crucial level.
A break down would draw in many who wanted to hedge against a fall prices. Likewise a market break up would bring in new buyers, he said.
